lines.text: Oooh, that Bill!\c\nI heard that he’ll do anything to get his hands on\nrare Pokémon. Anything at all!

Have you heard about Bill?\c
Everyone calls him a Pokémon fanatic!\c
But with a collection like his, who wouldn’t want
to brag a little bit?\c
I think people are just jealous!

There are two types of attacking moves:
physical moves and special moves.\c
If your Pokémon’s Attack stat is high, teach it
physical moves.

Why don’t you trade Pokémon with your friends?
You could get a lot more variety by trading.\c
The Pokémon you get in trades grow
quickly, too.
There’s a book called Pokémon Journal:\nInterviews.

“Future Activities of Pokémon Fanatic Bill\c
“‘Well, I’m researching about how to become
a Pokémon!\c
“‘...It’s just a joke!
Don’t take it seriously!\c
“‘Actually, I’m doing research on understanding
the minds of Pokémon.\c
“‘I want to understand what they are thinking!’”
